name: Callisto
source:
You play the role of a former military officer, now trying to make a living by trading and scavenging in the vastness of space. Your ship the Callisto and rag-tag crew, experiencing new adventures and relationships along its travels.​

[From [url=https://f95zone.to/threads/callisto-v0-1-xavster.34378/]F95Zone[/url]]
translation:
你扮演一名前军官，现在试图通过在广阔的太空中进行贸易和拾荒来谋生。你的船木卫四和乌合之众的船员，在旅途中经历新的冒险和人际关系。​

[来自[url=https://f95zone.to/threads/callisto-v0-1-xavster.34378/]F95Zone[/url]]
